help.dobHelp: Use the date on your passport.
help.countryHelp: Write the country name in English or French as on IRCC forms.
help.designeeHelp: A friend or family member who is not your paid representative.
help.commonLawHelp: Living together as a couple for at least 12 months, not married.
help.custodianHelp: Usually required for minors studying in Canada.

help.natIdHelp: National ID card issued by your country (not passport).
help.usCardHelp: Green card / permanent resident card for the United States.
help.previouslyMarriedHelp: Include dissolved marriages and common-law unions.

help.dliHelp: Starts with O followed by digits — from your school’s offer letter.
help.caqHelp: Required for most study programs in Quebec.
help.palHelp: Provincial attestation letter when required by your province.
help.lmiaHelp: Labour Market Impact Assessment or offer of employment number.
help.educationHelp: Post-secondary studies completed before this application.
help.bgTbHelp: Include active or past tuberculosis when asked by IRCC.
help.cicConsentHelp: Lets IRCC verify information with third parties.
